sentences.en: To be precise, I go, because I am forced to.
sentences.zh: 准确地说，我去是因为不得不去。

sentences.en: This is a precise and poetic paean to the peregrine.
sentences.zh: 这是一首对游隼精确而富有诗意的颂歌。

sentences.en: The manager gave the precise answer which I was looking for.
sentences.zh: 经理给了我期待的答案。

senses.zh: 精确的，准确的；恰好的，确切的；（人）严格的，一丝不苟的
